As Dr Pepper Snapple Group (DPS) Shares Rose, Holder Ibm Retirement Fund Has Upped Its Stake; Rafferty Asset Management Continues to Hold Stake in First Rep Bk San Francisco C (FRC)
May 30, 2018 - By Elijah Rosenthal
Ibm Retirement Fund increased its stake in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc (DPS) by 96.64% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ibm Retirement Fund bought 2,761 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.79% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 5,618 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $665,000, up from 2,857 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ibm Retirement Fund who had been investing in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.61 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.39% or $0.47 during the last trading session, reaching $119.89. About 513,190 shares traded. Dr Pepper Snapple Group, Inc. (NYSE:DPS) has risen 29.00% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.43% the S&P500.
Rafferty Asset Management Llc increased its stake in First Rep Bk San Francisco C (FRC) by 16.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rafferty Asset Management Llc bought 6,717 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.55% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 46,895 shares of the company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.34 million, up from 40,178 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rafferty Asset Management Llc who had been investing in First Rep Bk San Francisco C for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.89 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.81% or $1.81 during the last trading session, reaching $98.1. About 877,809 shares traded. First Republic Bank (NYSE:FRC) has risen 7.17% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.40% the S&P500.
Among 19 analysts covering First Republic Bank ( NYSE:FRC ), 8 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 42% are positive. First Republic Bank had 87 analyst reports since October 6, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. JMP Securities initiated First Republic Bank (NYSE:FRC) on Thursday, February 2 with “Mkt Outperform” rating. Keefe Bruyette & Woods maintained First Republic Bank (NYSE:FRC) rating on Monday, February 26. Keefe Bruyette & Woods has “Hold” rating and $95.0 target. RBC Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Friday, July 7 report. Jefferies maintained First Republic Bank (NYSE:FRC) on Wednesday, October 18 with “Buy” rating. The stock of First Republic Bank (NYSE:FRC) has “Buy” rating given on Monday, February 22 by Jefferies. The firm has “Hold” rating by RBC Capital Markets given on Friday, July 14. The stock of First Republic Bank (NYSE:FRC) earned “Hold” rating by Jefferies on Wednesday, April 18. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Monday, December 18 by BMO Capital Markets. Maxim Group maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, December 19 report. The stock has “Equal-Weight” rating by Barclays Capital on Monday, October 16.
More news for First Republic Bank (NYSE:FRC) were recently published by: Bizjournals.com , which released: “Why First Republic Bank is chasing the wealthy in Wyoming” on May 07, 2018. Bizjournals.com ‘s article titled: “Inside First Republic Bank’s culture of success” and published on May 17, 2018 is yet another important article.
Rafferty Asset Management Llc, which manages about $7.35 billion and $6.75 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Netflix Inc (NASDAQ:NFLX) by 2,021 shares to 7,379 shares, valued at $2.18M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Penn Natl Gaming Inc (NASDAQ:PENN) by 63,408 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 31,107 shares, and cut its stake in Tcf Finl Corp (NYSE:TCB).
Ibm Retirement Fund, which manages about $540.67 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Exxon Mobil Corp (NYSE:XOM) by 11,162 shares to 99,354 shares, valued at $7.41M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in J P Morgan Chase And Co (NYSE:JPM) by 9,073 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 80,892 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL).

(NYSE:DPS) has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, October 26 by Cowen & Co. On Monday, September 11 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy”. (NYSE:DPS) on Tuesday, January 30 with “Buy” rating. Stifel Nicolaus maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, March 14 report.
